graph.title: Bricktober Pizza Place (40181)
notes: The booklet has three models: the Pizza Place shop (steps 1-24), a white delivery van (p18-19) and a brown/dark truck (p20-21). All three are built.

Pieces are named by the Element IDs printed on the inventory page. The page is low resolution, so some IDs may be misread. Where an ID is in the catalogue I used that type, even if its catalogue name differs from the piece pictured. For example lego-4632571 is used for the black 1x2 wheel-holder plate, and lego-302401 for the white 1x1 plate.
Exact stud positions are hard to read from the small isometric images. Which parent a piece sits on is a best guess, and some roof-level attachments are approximate. Piece counts match the inventory.
The wheel holders have only one catalogue port (bar.1), so both wheels on a holder join to that port.
Step 10: the white slope b44 is placed on the third clear 1x1 brick. The white 1x1 plate b43 is placed on the first.
Step 19 (3x stack of two white plates and a red plate) is a repeat. Copies attach to b83, b84 and b63.
Step 12 and step 22 build small stacked round-plate pieces (barrel and chimney). They are modelled as stacks of round plates, topped by a round tile.
Technic connectors (4121715) are shown in pin-holes of the dark gray technic bricks and modelled as joined pin/pin-hole.
The van and truck share a build pattern: body plate, two wheel holders, then plates on top. Their internal arrangement is approximate.
